scope: What Studio executes itself with bundled tools, what each tool needs from the host, what it delivers and what to deliver instead when a requirement is missing. Host tools and external providers are listed only to mark the boundary. A requirement is checked in the current host before a file is promised; a listed observation is past evidence, not a guarantee for another host or day.

host_profiles.code_execution: The conversation can run Python in a sandbox (ordinary ChatGPT or ChatGPT Work with code execution). Whether Node.js, ffmpeg, numpy or a browser exist there is checked by trying, not assumed. ChatGPT Work's sandbox had Node.js, FFmpeg, Chromium and the npm registry (owner test 2026-10-14), so HyperFrames installs there on request for the session.
host_profiles.shell: A local shell, for example Codex or a local project, usually with Python, Node.js 20 and sometimes a local Chrome or Chromium.
host_profiles.none: No code execution, for example voice or a host with code execution switched off. Studio writes text, contracts and prompts only.

capabilities.does: Sets exact copy, price, logo and legal lines on a generated, supplied or flat background in a bundled or user font; PNG or JPG at the exact size and a print PDF with bleed; stops on cropped text or missing glyphs and measures contrast
capabilities.delivers: PNG or JPG at the exact size, a print PDF with bleed when asked, the <id>.static.json spec and the <id>.audit.json text and contrast audit
capabilities.when_missing: Use one-pass generation with the exact copy in the prompt and inspect every letter of the render; say the exact-copy route was not available

capabilities.does: Sets a wordmark as outlined SVG paths from a bundled or supplied font with its own kerning and Polish letterforms: colour, black and white versions, PNG renders, a clear-space and small-size preview and a report with the font licence
capabilities.delivers: wordmark.svg, wordmark-black.svg, wordmark-white.svg, PNG renders, wordmark-preview.png and wordmark.json
capabilities.when_missing: Specify the wordmark (font, case, tracking, colours, clear space) for a designer to set in a vector editor and say no vector file was made
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-11: container tests; advances match HarfBuzz and fills match the font rasterizer

capabilities.does: Measures an actual raster output: size and ratio against the placement or print size, effective resolution with bleed, transparency, relative sharpness, OCR against the locked copy when OCR is installed; writes phone, thumbnail, greyscale and safe-area previews
capabilities.delivers: A measurement report and preview images for the reviewer to look at
capabilities.when_missing: Inspect the image directly and state its size from the file; say the measurements and previews were not produced

capabilities.does: Checks Polish copy for typography, money, date and time formats, sentence-case headlines and one form of address, applies only typographic fixes, and counts characters against dated channel limits
capabilities.delivers: A findings report, the typographically fixed text when asked, and each field's length against its channel
capabilities.when_missing: Apply the Polish copy standard by reading and count characters by hand; say the automatic check was not run

capabilities.does: Checks whether a voice-over script fits its video length: words and Polish syllables against the short-form timing card, the pause after punctuation, and how much to cut
capabilities.delivers: Words, estimated seconds, the budget for the length and a verdict as JSON or a Markdown row
capabilities.when_missing: Count the words by hand against the timing card table and say the check was manual

capabilities.does: Prices a creative offer from the user's own rates: packages, hourly or day items, extras, discount, VAT or a stated exemption, advance payment; writes the offer document in Polish or English
capabilities.delivers: Totals per package as JSON and the offer as Markdown
capabilities.when_missing: Compute each line by hand and show the arithmetic; never fill in rates the user has not given

capabilities.does: Lays out a brand guide from the brand kit: logo versions, clear space, colours with HEX, RGB and WCAG contrast, type samples, voice, claims and rules, with missing parts printed as missing
capabilities.delivers: brand-guide.pdf and one PNG per page
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the guide content as a structured document and say the layout file was not made

capabilities.does: Composes a storyboard into PNG pages and one PDF: frames in a grid with exact labels in the bundled Inter, placeholders for missing frames, labels never cut
capabilities.delivers: Board pages as PNG and a PDF
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the board specification (panel map and labels) and say the file was not composed

capabilities.does: Exports a shot list, an AV script or any table as XLSX (standard library), CSV and a printable PDF with exact text
capabilities.delivers: XLSX and CSV; the PDF needs Pillow
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the table in Markdown and say no file was made
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-11: container tests; the XLSX read back with openpyxl

capabilities.does: Checks a structured shot plan for interval gaps, duplicate IDs, missing bridges and unbound references, with the same rules and result as the Node checker
capabilities.delivers: The structural verdict, errors, blockers and human review items as JSON
capabilities.when_missing: Check the intervals and bridges by hand and say so
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-11: container tests; 24 plans give identical results in Python and Node

capabilities.does: Exports a video prompt pack as Markdown copy blocks, CSV and JSONL, and checks IDs, durations, reference files and coverage of the shot plan before generation
capabilities.delivers: Prompt files and findings
capabilities.when_missing: Give each prompt in its own block and check the list by hand

capabilities.does: Measures generated or supplied clips and puts their first, middle and last frames on one sheet, flagging clips shorter than their shot, the wrong ratio or frame rate
capabilities.delivers: contact-sheet.png and review.json
capabilities.when_missing: Ask for the clip details from the generator and review the clips one by one

capabilities.does: Generates or edits an image with the host's own image tool when the host exposes one
capabilities.delivers: The host's generated image, inspected before it is called a result
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the final prompt as a standalone code block for the user's own tool
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-08: ordinary ChatGPT generated storyboard boards on request (owner report)

capabilities.does: Video generators such as Veo, Gemini Omni, Kling, Seedance, Wan, MiniMax H3 or Runway run outside Studio; the dated video-generator snapshot in Research maps them
capabilities.delivers: A prompt for the named generator, researched for its current version and surface
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the prompt; review a clip the user supplies

capabilities.does: Song, voice and music generators such as Suno, ElevenLabs or Flow Music run outside Studio
capabilities.delivers: Prompts, lyrics and production packets for the named tool
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the packet; for a motion video Studio renders or a video the user supplies, the motion sound engine designs the sound instead where code runs

capabilities.does: Reads current sources when the conditional research gate triggers
capabilities.delivers: An evidence note with sources and access dates
capabilities.when_missing: Where code runs, read public sources with web_reach; otherwise say once that current sources could not be checked and mark mutable claims unverified
capabilities.observed: Depends on the host's search or browsing tool

capabilities.does: Searches the open skills.sh catalog with its security audits, reads a candidate's SKILL.md description and, for one-time use of a listed skill, its text at a pinned commit; installs nothing
capabilities.delivers: Catalog candidates with what they do, installs, audits and verdict, offered by request or when a task needs what Studio lacks; one-time use or an install command only on the user's answer
capabilities.when_missing: Search skills.sh with the host's web search (one-time use only when its audits read low or safe), else give the link with search keywords; installing needs Codex or Claude Code
capabilities.observed: Container checks against the live catalog only

capabilities.does: Lists the owner-reviewed outside repositories that can be added as engines or knowledge, with their status per host, rights terms and pinned plan, install, verify and remove commands; installs nothing itself
capabilities.delivers: The fitting extensions for this host and, on an explicit request, the dry-run plan, installation and verification
capabilities.when_missing: Read the registry file and give the steps for Codex or Claude Code
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-15: container checks; REA's dry-run plans only

capabilities.does: Runs the bundled Logo Design tools through a Studio adapter: blank project, reference-catalogue search, SVG craft audit, preview/concept/presentation sheets, colour/mono variants and optional PNG/favicon exports. Checks actual renderer availability.
capabilities.delivers: Editable logo source, SVG/HTML review assets, scoped advisory audit and export manifest; PNG/icons only with an available renderer. Reference trademark files are not bundled.
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver design direction and exact missing runtime requirements; do not claim an audit or render ran.
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-17: local Python/CairoSVG build and export tests; fresh ChatGPT/Work invocation not_run

capabilities.does: Flags machine-made design tells in HTML, CSS and SVG: default indigo, purple or trust gradients, emoji icons, system-sans display, left-accent cards, invented metrics, filler copy, untracked caps, raw hex, accent overuse, placeholder images
capabilities.delivers: P0 and P1 findings with evidence; exit 1 while a P0 remains
capabilities.when_missing: Review the source or the rendered page by eye against craft-rules.md

capabilities.does: Exports a brand kit to DESIGN.md, tokens.css and an Open Design manifest, and imports colours, fonts and don'ts from a DESIGN.md package
capabilities.delivers: A DESIGN.md package, or a brand kit with placeholders for what the file does not state
capabilities.when_missing: Write the DESIGN.md sections by hand from the kit, or copy the colours and fonts into the kit template

capabilities.does: Searches 87 licensed worked prompts for gpt-image-2, Seedance 2.0 and HyperFrames and prints each with its credit line
capabilities.delivers: Prompt text verbatim with author, source and licence
capabilities.when_missing: Read examples.json and filter by model

capabilities.does: Finds machine-made writing patterns in English or Polish copy (empty vocabulary, inflated significance, unproven social proof, negative parallelism, forced threes, chatbot closers, generic CTAs, filler) and judges whether they cluster
capabilities.delivers: Pattern findings with examples and a clean, check or cluster verdict
capabilities.when_missing: Read the draft against ai-writing-patterns.md and its checklist

capabilities.does: Computes WCAG contrast between two colours with verdicts for body text, large text and interface parts
capabilities.delivers: The ratio and three pass or fail verdicts; a self-test of the reference pairs
capabilities.when_missing: Apply the WCAG formula by hand as written in the craft rules

capabilities.does: Builds a manifest of project files with revisions and finds which outputs depend on a changed source
capabilities.delivers: A manifest JSON and the list of outputs affected by a change
capabilities.when_missing: Keep the inventory as a table in the project state and trace dependencies by hand

capabilities.does: Checks which tools behind the capability card are installed in this host and prints install steps for the missing ones
capabilities.delivers: A per-tool report: found, version, missing, and the install step for this system
capabilities.when_missing: Probe by hand (node -v, ffmpeg -version, python3 -c "import PIL") and say what was not checked

capabilities.does: Reads a public page, feed, GitHub repository or video subtitles without a login when the host has no browsing tool; refuses private addresses and prints source and date
capabilities.delivers: Readable text or entries with the source URL and retrieval date for the evidence note
capabilities.when_missing: Use the host's search or browsing tool, or say once that current sources could not be checked

capabilities.does: Checks one structured planning record for an image or a video and compiles it into the generator's own form: Ideogram 4.x native JSON, the FLUX.2 JSON template, Kling custom multi-shot fields, Sora headed blocks, timestamped or plain prose
capabilities.delivers: The compiled prompt or payload for the named generator and a list of errors and warnings (gaps, durations, dialogue length, settings in prose)
capabilities.when_missing: Write the record and the compiled prompt by hand from the structured prompt cards and run the same checks by reading
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-25: container tests only (13 cases); no generator was run
